hp-ord.name: ORD – Word comprehension
hp-ord.description: Pick the word closest in meaning. Five options, 10 tasks per section.

hp-las.name: LÄS – Swedish reading
hp-las.description: Swedish texts with questions on main idea, detail and inference. Four options. Text stays in Swedish.

hp-mek.name: MEK – Sentence completion
hp-mek.description: A sentence with gaps — pick the option whose words fill every gap. Four options. In Swedish.

hp-elf.name: ELF – English reading
hp-elf.description: English texts with comprehension questions. Four options.

hp-xyz.name: XYZ – Mathematical problem solving
hp-xyz.description: Maths problems with five options, 12 per section. In Swedish.

hp-kva.name: KVA – Quantitative comparisons
hp-kva.description: Compare two quantities I and II. Four fixed options, 12 per section. In Swedish.

hp-nog.name: NOG – Quantitative reasoning
hp-nog.description: Is the information in statements (1) and (2) sufficient? Five fixed options. In Swedish.

hp-dtk.name: DTK – Diagrams, tables and maps
hp-dtk.description: Interpret a diagram, table or map. Five options, 10 per section. In Swedish.
